facts.business: Nikki Global Finance Limited is an NBFC focused on financial inclusion, providing lending solutions to niche and underbanked segments in India.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company enters FY 2026-27 with renewed confidence, prioritising stronger underwriting standards, deeper digital integration, and more robust recovery mechanisms. The year ahead will see the Company build on this momentum, growing its loan book cautiously, sharpening asset quality, and working purposefully to sustain and deepen profitability.

key_risks: Credit risk — arising from the possibility of borrower default.
Liquidity risk — stemming from potential mismatches in asset-liability tenures or constrained access to funding during periods of market stress.
Interest rate risk — volatility that can compress net interest margins and elevate borrowing costs.

Regulatory risk — an evolving compliance landscape under RBI and other regulatory bodies, where tightening norms or revised provisioning requirements could influence profitability and capital adequacy.
